notes: Recruits text first. After a big win, a bad loss, a Top 25 ranking, an injury at their position, a rival coach's offer, another commit at their spot, or a word about your program's identity, recruits (and the occasional mom) reach out on their own. Inbound texts cost no hours; a 'texts waiting' pill in the header and a 'Texted you' tag on the Recruit tab show who. Leave one on read for a week and he notices. Your own commits text too, and one answer can turn into a playing-time promise.
